title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Trial of Disputes over Patent Application Rights
keywords_en: Court's provisions on trial of disputes over patent application rights
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Several Issues Concerning the Trial of Disputes over Patent Application Rights

Fa (Jing) Fa [1987] No. 29

People's courts at all levels throughout the country, military courts at all levels, intermediate and basic railway transport courts, and maritime courts:

Since the implementation of the Patent Law, disputes over patent application rights have occurred from time to time. In order to correctly implement the Patent Law and its implementing regulations, properly resolve disputes over patent application rights, and protect the lawful rights and interests of holders of patent application rights, the following matters are hereby notified:

1. Where a party, dissatisfied with the decision of its superior competent authority or the patent administrative authority in its locality regarding a dispute over patent application rights, institutes legal proceedings in a people's court, the people's court shall accept the case.

2. Cases of disputes over patent application rights include:
   (1) Cases of disputes over whether an invention-creation is a service invention-creation or a non-service invention-creation;
   (2) Cases of disputes over who is the inventor or designer of an invention-creation;
   (3) Cases of disputes over who has the right to apply for a patent for an invention-creation completed through collaboration (cooperation) or through acceptance of a commission.

3. The jurisdiction over cases of disputes over patent application rights shall be handled in accordance with the provisions of Item 2 of the Notice on Several Issues Concerning the Initiation of Patent Trial Work issued by this Court on February 16, 1985, that is, the intermediate people's courts in the locations of the people's governments of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, the intermediate people's courts of special economic zones, and such intermediate people's courts as are designated by the high people's courts of provinces and autonomous regions based on actual needs and approved by this Court shall serve as courts of first instance.

4. After a judgment made by a people's court on a dispute over patent application rights becomes legally effective, it shall be promptly copied to the Patent Office of the People's Republic of China. If, during the process of examination or reexamination of an opposition or a request for invalidation, the Patent Office or the Patent Reexamination Board finds that the opposition or request for invalidation is directed against a patent application right that has already been confirmed by a people's court, and the opponent or the person requesting invalidation has submitted new evidence and grounds, the patent examination or reexamination proceedings shall be suspended, and the new evidence and grounds shall be forwarded to the relevant people's court. The relevant people's court shall carefully examine and handle the matter, and shall notify the opponent or the person requesting invalidation and the Patent Office or the Patent Reexamination Board of the results of its handling.

5. In order to prevent the loss of novelty of an invention-creation, a people's court shall maintain confidentiality when trying a case of dispute over patent application rights concerning a patent application that has not yet been published.

October 19, 1987
